notes.title: Update details 21/11/2023
notes.notes:
- A 'Skip Scene' button has been implemented to make the game more dynamic and allow players to skip animations if they find it necessary.

-Automatic saving has been implemented, where players who wish to save automatically after each chapter should mark this option in the menu.
